login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to find your next squad.
login.tagline:
Find your squad.
Whenever you want to play.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join the community and find players like you.
register.incompleteDetail: Fill in all the required fields

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to create a new password.
reset.sent: If an account exists with that email, we sent you a link to reset your password. Check your spam folder too.
reset.providersHelp: If you signed up with Google, use "Continue with Google"; if you sign in with Steam, use Steam. Those accounts don't have a password.

verify.bannerText: We sent a link to {{email}}. Until then you can browse, but not post, comment, chat or add friends.
verify.dialogText: To post, comment, chat or add friends you need to verify your email. Open the link we sent to {{email}}.
verify.dialogHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder or ask for another one.
verify.sentDetail: We sent a new link to {{email}}.
verify.doneDetail: You can now post, comment, chat and add friends.
verify.notYetDetail: Open the link in the email and try again.
verify.sendFailedDetail: Your account was created, but we couldn't send the verification email; you can resend it from the notice.

profileRecovered.title: We completed your profile
profileRecovered.detail: Your profile wasn't saved properly when you created your account. Check your nickname and country in My profile.

ageGate.title: Confirm your age
ageGate.text: GamerMatch is only for people aged 18 or older. To continue, confirm that you are 18 or older.
ageGate.legal: More information in the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
ageGate.saveError: Your answer could not be saved. Please try again.

usernamePrompt.title: Choose your nickname
usernamePrompt.text: It's the nickname others will see on GamerMatch. It's public: anyone can see it, even without logging in, so avoid your real name if you don't want it known.
usernamePrompt.label: Nickname
usernamePrompt.hint: If you choose "Not now", you'll stay as {{current}} and can change it anytime in My profile.
usernamePrompt.taken: That nickname is already taken. Choose another one.
usernamePrompt.error: It couldn't be saved. Please try again.
